variants.label: A — 電影感運動海報
variants.prompt:
Create one wide landscape 16:9 hero artwork for a clean sport education website. Fictional adult sports people: a female runner in foreground, a cyclist wearing a helmet, and a basketball player. They are imaginary people, no likeness to any known athlete. Deep forest green, emerald, teal, warm ivory with restrained amber highlights. Place the sports group in the RIGHT 60 percent, leave the LEFT 40 percent as calm dark forest green negative space for a website heading later added in HTML. Keep all heads fully visible with generous safe margin at top and outer right edge. Positive confident sporting mood, natural anatomy, no medications, no needles, no trophies, no official emblems. Absolutely NO text, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, UI, borders, collage panels or labels. This is a single finished illustration, not a website screenshot.
Style: cinematic sports campaign digital artwork. Dramatic stadium rim light, luminous teal motion trails, fine suspended water particles, powerful athletic movement, rich deep shadows, sophisticated photographic realism with obviously composed fantasy arena backdrop. Crisp premium sports advertising quality. Dark green quiet left side must remain uncluttered, group distinct on the right. Do not copy Nike or any other brand campaign.
